title: thymus serpyllum f. stenophyllus
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. stenophyllus, commonly known as creeping thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus serpyllum plant, a low-growing, spreading evergreen herb native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may aid in soothing respiratory issues, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of creeping thyme include expectorant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help relieve coughs, colds, and other respiratory complaints, as well as reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of creeping thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and borneol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional herbal remedies.
